translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Galatia
book.title: Surat Ni Paulus Bona Jama'at Na Libutan GALATIA

content: Tabea'

Yaku' i Paulus men poposuu'. Yaku' nosida poposuu' taasi'po ia sidakon mian kabai ia nakat mian, kasee ia sidakon i Yesus Kristus ka' Alaata'ala, Tama na surugaa, men nomotuo'i i Yesus noko daa lapus.
Yaku' ka' giigii' utus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an men isian tii yaku' munsurati i kuu mianna jama'at men isian na libutan Galatia.
Sulano kaporean ka' koratongan men ringkat na Alaata'ala Tamanta ka' i Tumpu Yesus Kristus surionmuu na tutuo'muu.
Yesus nongorookon waka-Na bookoi kurbaan gause dosanta, kada' i kita sianmo bariosonna kuasa men ba'idek tempo koini'i. Ia nangawawau koiya'a gause pingkira'na Alaata'ala, Tamanta.
Tontunde' a Alaata'ala pataka sidutu! Amin.
Sa'a-sa'angu' a Lele Pore men daa tuutuu'

Kosamba'ku tuu' i kuu! Kuu ia leelo'mo Alaata'ala gause kaporean ni Kristus, kasee koini'i i kuu dongan tuu' montotokurung Alaata'ala ka' mongololo' lele pore sambanaan, taasi'po Lele Pore men tuutuu'na.
Bookoi sianta lele pore sambanaan. Tongko' se' isian mian men mangararanga' i kuu ka' mansarak mombolii Lele Pore men muntundun i Kristus.
Mian men mengelelekon lele pore sambanaan saliwakon Lele Pore men kai lelekonmo, patalai i ia bi kana'a tadean, mau mian iya'a tonsoop mianmai kabai malaa'ikat na surugaa.
Kai poko bantilkonmo mbaripianpo, koini'i bantilkononku soosoodo: Imepo a mian men mengelelekon lele pore sambanaan men poosasala' tia men kuu labotmo na ko'omai, patalai i ia bi kana'a tadean.

Ansee koi upa i yaku' koini'i? Too i yaku' mingkira' tunde'onna mian, kabai tunde'onna Alaata'ala? Kabai yaku' mansarak bo pangalangku noana mian? Kalu se' i yaku' dauga' mansarak mangala noana mian, mbaka' i yaku' taasi'mo ata' ni Kristus.
Sasalan ni Paulus nosida Poposuu'
Utu-utusku! Kuu tio minginti'i se' Lele Pore men malia' lelekononku iya'a taasi' nimpu'u na mian.
Lele Pore iya'a taasipo yaku' labot na mian ka' taasi' mian a nimisiso'kon na ingku', kasee i Yesus Kristus a men nompopo'inti'ikon na ingku'.
Kuu sabole nongorongormo tutuo'ku mbaripian tempo i yaku' dauga' na agama Yahudi. Inti'ionmuu se' dodoa tuu' a pantalalaisku jama'atna Alaata'ala ka' mampari-pari mamakabus.
Mian men sangkorap tii yaku' na lipu'ku Yahudi, sianta men mangkana'i lesi'ku mongololoikon aturanna pulimai.
Kasee ka' kaporeanna Alaata'ala, Ia nungururuki i yaku' tempo i yaku' dauga' na lalomna kompongna sinangku, ka' Ia nengeleelo' i yaku'.
Ia maloos a noa-Na mimpipiile'kon Anak-Na na ingku' kada' Anak iya'a sida lelekononku na mian na lipu' sambana men taasi' Yahudi. Titiu'po yaku' sian nomae' miki ururanii na sa'angu'po mian.

Yaku' uga' sian nomae' na mian men isian na Yerusalem men olukonanpo noko sidamo poposuu' sianpo tia i yaku' nosida poposuu'. Kasee i yaku' nomae' na tano' Arab, kasi na tano' Arab nomule'kon na Damsyik.
Sarataa tolu' taun, yaku' nomae'mo na Yerusalem mengelego'i i Kefas. Yaku' nodumodongo tii ia koi sompulo' lima' ilio.
Kasee i yaku' sian nopootuung tia poposuu' men sambanaan saliwakon i Yakobus men utus ni Tumpu Yesus.
Alaata'ala mimiile' se' tundunanku men yaku' tulis bo ko'omuu kani'i tuutuu'. Yaku' sian mimborek.
Kasi yaku' nomae' na libutan Siria ka' libutan Kilikia.
Kasee jama'at ni Kristus na Yudea sian ninginti'i se' yaku'mo i Paulus.

Raaya'a tongko' nongorongor tundunanna mian men mangaan taena, “Mian men mbaripian nantalalais i kai men parasaya ni Kristus, koini'i mengelelekon kaparasaya'an men mbaripian pari-parionna popopenta'on.”
Raaya'a sida nuntunde' Alaata'ala gause upa men Ia limangmo na ingku'.
